issues: Most ₹ value tiles show ₹0 because legacy inventory items in DB lack `rate`/`average_rate` fields — dashboard aggregation is correct, just data-dependent. Consider seeding sample rates or surfacing this clearly in empty state.

action_items: (optional, low) Dashboard tiles read item.rate / item.average_rate — most legacy items have neither field, so ₹ totals show 0. Either backfill last_purchase_rate -> rate at seed, or fall back to last_purchase_rate inside _cat_value/total_value aggregator.

(optional) os-save testid is only mounted after user clicks 'New Opening Stock' (form lives in a modal). Acceptable, but consider exposing data-testid='os-new' on the open button so smoke tests can find it deterministically.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory_master_router.py L488 — os_number derivation uses count_documents which is racy under concurrency (two parallel POSTs could collide). Acceptable for v1 but switch to an atomic counter collection or unique index on os_number before high-volume use.

_post_opening_stock writes balance_after using the value already-incremented inventory.quantity, which is correct — but it re-reads the doc per line so under concurrent multi-line updates the balance_after could be skewed. Consider transactional session or per-line snapshot in same update.
dashboard aggregation iterates all items in Python (L609 to_list(10000)). For >10k SKUs this is slow — push aggregation to MongoDB ($group) when item count grows.
/inv/settings PUT silently drops bogus keys (good) but does not return a 422/400 when ALL keys are invalid; caller can't tell their payload was ignored. Consider warning in response.
